question_text: When wind blows over the surface of a still lake, a bunch of water hyacinth floating on water as shown in Figure is observed to move in the direction of the wind with a velocity $v$. Consider the following statements regarding about the motion of the bunch:

options.option_text: Magnitude of $v$ depends on the mass of the bunch.
Magnitude of $v$ depends on the rate at which the momentum is transferred from air molecules to the bunch.
Magnitude of $v$ depends on the viscosity of water.
Only A and B are true.
Only A, B and C are true.
